fail_closed_checks: Every frozen binding path exists and has the exact declared SHA-256 before any later implementation or execution is considered.
Base and checkpoint-176 use the identical QK_BFP8_E16_HEAD64_V1 encoding, packing, rounding, and dot-product rules; model-specific Q/K representation parameters are forbidden.
Every nonzero finite BF16 head is assigned the least exponent e satisfying max_abs <= 127 * 2^e; zero heads use e=0.
Every encoded mantissa is in [-127,+127], payload -128 is forbidden, and no saturating or clamping operation exists in the Q/K encode, cache, decode, multiply, or 64-lane reduction path.
Any non-finite source value, non-canonical exponent, reserved payload, arithmetic overflow, input drift, packing drift, or cost mismatch rejects the contract or a future realization without scoring.
Review is static and non-scoring: it must not load a model, inspect hidden outputs, run inference, generate text, calculate evaluator metrics, replay repair work, or create a candidate/package.

authority_boundary.claim: This artifact defines and statically reviews one software representation contract only. It is not a candidate, alternative selection, implementation package, executable action, score, stage transition, or RTL authority.
requires_separate_fresh_authority_for: RTL, specification, manifest, synthesis, PPA, FPGA, or U280 work

evidence_basis.known_limit: The sealed repair-0003 artifacts omit clamp-event coordinates for six nonzero cases. This contract does not reconstruct them and does not claim that the representation passes rank-margin or quality gates.

objective: Freeze one deterministic, saturation-free software representation shared by Q and K for Base and checkpoint-176, with exact integer bounds and storage costs, before any separately authorized implementation or quality evaluation.
prohibited_actions: Create or name a candidate, alternative selection, attempt, package, command bundle, execution namespace, marker, submission, or process.
Load either model; run inference, calibration, validation, evaluator scoring, continuation generation, repair replay, retraining, or hidden-output inspection.
Change frozen inputs, thresholds, scores, model weights, prior repair evidence, design/SPEC.md, benchmark or RTL manifests, RTL, constraints, research/PIPELINE_STATE.json, or U280 files.
Run elaboration, lint, simulation, regression, formal, synthesis, timing, area, PPA, FPGA emulation, bitstream generation, or board execution.
Claim rank-margin, readability, chat quality, candidate viability, Stage 1 completion, or a pipeline-stage transition.

representation.decoder: For every lane i, reconstructed_value[i] = signed_mantissa[i] * 2^signed_exponent. The same rule applies to Q and K for both bound models.

encoder.exponent_selection: For a nonzero 64-lane head of finite BF16 values, choose the least integer e such that max_i(abs(x_i)) <= 127 * 2^e. This definition is exact and must be implemented from BF16 sign/exponent/fraction fields without host-libm dependence.
encoder.mantissa_quantization: m_i = round_to_nearest_ties_to_even(x_i * 2^-e). Clamping and saturation are forbidden; the exponent rule guarantees m_i is in [-127,+127].
encoder.non_finite_policy: Any NaN or infinity rejects the record before payload creation.
encoder.source_domain: The finite BF16 post-RoPE Q or K head values defined by the bound c02 fixed software reference; upstream projection, RoPE coefficient, and model weights are not changed by this contract.

representation.joint_score_rule: For one query head and its mapped key head, score_mantissa = sum over 64 lanes of q_mantissa[i] * k_mantissa[i], score_exponent = q_exponent + k_exponent, and the exact represented pre-scale dot product is score_mantissa * 2^score_exponent. No intermediate requantization, residual sideband, diagonal gain, saturation, or clamp is permitted.

key_head_record.layout: bytes 0..63 are lane 0..63 signed int8 mantissas; bytes 64..65 are the signed int16 little-endian head exponent; no padding

packing.key_record_order: layer, token, kv_head, then the 66-byte key-head record

query_head_record.lifetime: transient software working storage only; never persisted in KV cache

packing.value_cache: Unchanged signed-int8 V payload and frozen model-specific V scale from the bound software contract.

representation.scope_end: The exact (score_mantissa, score_exponent) pair is the contract output. Causal masking, row centering, Q6.9 conversion, softmax, and quality/rank-margin evaluation are outside this bounded prerequisite and require separate fresh authority.

static_review.method: Static contract and checksum review only; no model, repair, evaluator, generation, RTL, or pipeline execution.
